notes.source: Actual archived Shrek SuperSlam OBJ geometry and UV textures from FliQuaDv. No new body meshes or drawn sprite anatomy.
notes.animation: All joint recipes are authored locally. The archive supplies no skeleton or animation clips.
notes.presentation: Real game geometry/UVs; original head pieces scaled1.4 at the neck; orthographic projection horizontally widened1.15. Fixed32x32 projection and integer anchors stabilize model texture pixels across poses. Source atlas is exact4x nearest replication of native textured render pixels.
notes.status: Inactive fixed-grid draft;194 authored model roles and62 preserved native blanks. No recovered game animation clips.
notes.blanks: All62 original blank frame IDs retain transparent output.
notes.nativeMirror: Right-facing roles mirror the complete rendered left-facing frame, using the existing native horizontal tile mirror convention. The genuine right-direction model renders remain in the source archive for comparison.
